name: get_status
title: Get Ananda status
description: Read active profile, EQ state, output connection, APO ownership, listening verification, window state and recent errors. A successful file commit is not proof of audible DSP.

name: list_profiles
title: List sound profiles
description: List profile IDs, names, headphone assignments, preamp, filter counts, provenance and active status.

name: get_profile
title: Read a complete EQ profile
description: Read every filter and GraphicEQ point. Use an exact profile ID or case-insensitive full name from list_profiles.

name: activate_profile
title: Activate a sound profile
description: Immediately activate the named profile through Equalizer APO. Does not open a window, require Apply, or restart audio. Use a profile ID or exact full name.

name: set_eq
title: Enable or bypass EQ
description: Set EQ on/off. Off selects Stock (0 dB, no filters); on restores the last enabled profile. Does not change Windows volume.

name: set_preamp
title: Set profile preamp
description: Set preamp in dB from -60 to +20. Editing the active profile applies immediately. Preserve user tuning unless asked to change it.

name: edit_filter
title: Edit an EQ filter
description: Patch an existing filter by its ID from get_profile. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Valid active-profile edits apply immediately.

name: add_filter
title: Add an EQ filter
description: Append a validated filter to a profile. Supported kinds are PK, LSC, HSC, HPQ, LPQ. Returns the updated profile including its new filter ID.

name: remove_filter
title: Remove an EQ filter
description: Remove one filter by ID from a profile. Use only when the user asks to remove it; editing an active profile applies immediately.

name: manage_profile
title: Create or manage a profile
description: Create, duplicate, rename, delete, or reorder a profile. Stock cannot be edited/deleted; switch away from active/last-enabled profiles before deletion. New and copied profiles are not automatically activated.

name: import_profile
title: Import EQ text or profile JSON
description: Import supplied Equalizer APO text or Ananda JSON as a new profile. Rejects unsupported commands and never executes Include, device, shell, or other arbitrary directives. Original profiles are preserved.

name: export_profile
title: Export profile data
description: Return a profile as APO text or Ananda JSON. Does not write arbitrary files or send data anywhere.

name: get_settings
title: Read preferences and headphones
description: Read background preferences, global hotkeys, headphone entries and selected headphone. No secrets or raw APO files are returned.

name: update_settings
title: Update Ananda preferences
description: Patch only supplied background preferences and shortcuts. Empty shortcut strings disable them. Conflicts are reported. Agent access itself cannot be enabled or disabled by an agent.

name: manage_headphone
title: Manage headphone entries
description: Create, rename, manually select, or delete an empty headphone entry. Selection changes profile browsing; it does not guess physical headphones attached to the DAC or automatically change EQ.

name: set_profile_headphone
title: Assign a profile to headphones
description: Move a profile to an existing headphone entry using its ID from get_settings. Stock is immutable.

name: control_window
title: Open or close the control center
description: Open a control-center page or request normal close (flushes valid pending edits). Profile and EQ tools do not require any window. Closing follows the user's close-to-tray preference.
